nodes.title: Speech: write the text, pick the model

widgets_values:
## Text to speech in 23 languages, Finnish with its own model

1. Load a clear recording of the voice to copy in **Voice sample**, 6 to 15 seconds.
2. Write the text in the speech node.
3. For Finnish keep `model` on the Finnish fine-tune. For another language set `model` to the multilingual model and pick the `language`.
4. Run. The result is saved in `output/audio/`.

The Finnish model is Finnish-NLP's fine-tune of the multilingual one on 16,604 Finnish clips. On Finnish speakers it was not trained on, its authors measured 2.76 % word errors, against 28.94 % for the multilingual model it started from.

`cfg_weight` sets how closely the speech follows the voice sample's pacing: 0.3 suits the Finnish model. With the multilingual model use 0.5 when the sample is in the text's language and 0 when it is not, or the voice keeps the sample's accent. `exaggeration` above 0.5 makes the delivery more expressive. Split long texts into a few sentences per run.

Multilingual model languages: Arabic, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Turkish.
nodes.title: How to use

widgets_values:
## About this workflow

Built for this repo on Resemble AI's Chatterbox multilingual model (MIT) and Finnish-NLP's [Chatterbox-Finnish](https://huggingface.co/Finnish-NLP/Chatterbox-Finnish) (MIT). Chatterbox Speech, a node of this repo's template pack, runs both with the Chatterbox code in filliptm's [ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox](https://github.com/filliptm/ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox) (MIT). It samples with upstream Chatterbox's alignment check, which ends each line once the text has been read; that pack's own nodes leave it out, and the multilingual model then talked on after most lines.

Sample voice `chatterbox_input_target_voice.mp3` from Comfy's template inputs.

Asset profile: `chatterbox-multilingual`.
